experiences.description: Leading a global team that shapes employee experience with internal technology at Shopify.

While working at Apple for over ten years, I held many positions, all of which focused on enriching the customer experience. Please see below:

Trainer (May 2006-April 2011): Creating and delivering training to customers as well as staff. Designing effective learning programs for businesses. 

Genius/Lead Genius (April 2011-September 2016): Certified Macintosh and iOS technician, tasked with repairing not only hardware and software, but customers relationships with said devices. Strategizing best practices around repair turnaround and in-store processes. Creating and facilitating on boarding material for employees. 

Expert (September 2016-November 2016): Motivating and mentoring a sales team of nearly 100 to create better relationships with customers. Partnering specifically with business customers to find the best solutions for them and their business.
Wrote & performed scheduled tests for internal Apple iOS applications used by all retail employees worldwide. Utilized JIRA software and Agile methodologies for testing.
